_comment: Situational animation mapping — the single source of truth for both packs.
Generated from the renamed/described inventory spreadsheet, then committed here.
Each clip carries WHAT IT DOES IN DIALOGUE ('functions') and HOW IT IS COLOURED
('manner'), not an emotion tag. Emotion no longer gates which body clip may play:
it persists on the FACE via the emotion state machine. 'manner' only breaks ties
and lets the director ask for an on-tone variant; it never restricts the pool.
functions: listening | explaining | making_point | agreeing | disagreeing |
'when' is the author's own description and is what the director is shown.
